speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress. To begin my assessment, are you pregnant, and if so, was it a term delivery? Did you experience any complications during labor or delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Diaphragmatic Hernia (CDH). The history of a preterm infant (32 weeks) born via C-section with immediate respiratory distress is highly suggestive of CDH, especially given the potential for missed prenatal diagnosis or rapid progression to pulmonary hypoplasia. I will proceed with a chest X-ray to confirm the diagnosis and assess bowel loops in the thorax.
